description: This file contains a React component for a login/signup page in a Next.js application. It includes UI elements, state management, and functions for setting authentication cookies, role switching, and routing logic.

methods.name: clampNextPath
methods.description: Ensures redirect paths are within an allowed set, preventing redirects to unsafe or login paths.

methods.name: setAuthCookie
methods.description: Sets a cookie with user role and email, timestamp included for authentication simulation.

methods.name: LoginClient
methods.description: React component rendering the login/create account interface with form handling and UI.
